pieces.Text: A secret seeker gains access to the prognostication and read aura occult skill unlocks (Occult Adventures p. 196-197), but not the other occult skill unlocks. If she ever chooses to gain the Psychic Sensitivity feat or otherwise gains access to all occult skill unlocks, she receives Psychic Maestro as a bonus feat, with prognostication and read aura as the two occult skill unlocks selected.
